request.style: English, orchestral, male solo voice with choir, strings, brass, timpani, harp, majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not be shaken in mind or alarmed
By a spirit or word or a letter
Saying the day of the Lord has come
Let no one deceive you in any way

[Verse]
That day will not come until the rebellion takes place
And the man of lawlessness is revealed
He exalts himself above every so-called god
Seating himself in the temple of God

[Chorus]
The Lord Jesus will destroy him
With the breath of his mouth
Bring him to nothing
By the splendor of his coming

[Verse]
His coming is by the working of Satan
With all power and false signs and wonders
Wicked deception for those who are perishing
They refused to love the truth and be saved

[Chorus]
The Lord Jesus will destroy him
With the breath of his mouth
Bring him to nothing
By the splendor of his coming

[Bridge]
God sends them a deluding power
So that they believe the lie
But we must always thank God for you
Chosen as firstfruits for salvation

[Outro]
Stand firm and hold fast to the traditions
May comfort and strength come to your hearts
